description:
Non material amendment of planning approval PA25/1854 to planning condition: C.26. NS29 Affordable Housing - PART 5 only - to now read:

5.	The following details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority at least six months prior to practical completion of the development hereby approved. The development shall not be implemented or occupied other than in accordance with the approved details. 

a.	details of the affordability of all the residential units, taking account of service charge and the affordability criteria 
b.	marketing strategy for all intermediate homes.
decision_conditions:
The applicant is informed that for the avoidance of doubt the details approved by this notice are as follows:-

Amendments to part 5 of condition NS29, as set out in the Covering Letter from Rebecca Neil, WSP dated 12 February 2026.
